research.searchCoverage: Official Pinecone Database control-plane list/describe index docs, Api-Key authentication, API versioning (2026-04 and 2026-07), New York Pinecone Systems identity, security center, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Pinecone's 2026-04-19 Vercel advisory states Pinecone was not compromised. No current unresolved platform breach is asserted; this is dated coverage and not a breach-free claim.

Official Pinecone Database control-plane list/describe index docs, Api-Key authentication, API versioning, Pinecone Systems, Inc. US identity, and dated incident/control search reviewed on 2026-09-13. The April 2026 Vercel advisory is recorded as a third-party event Pinecone reported it was not affected by. Data-plane index hosts are caller-supplied and admitted only after handwritten https + *.pinecone.io checks.

incidents.affectedData: Pinecone reported no compromise of Pinecone credentials, customer data, or API services.
incidents.remediation: Pinecone rotated Vercel environment variables, verified Context.ai was not in Google Workspace, reviewed Vercel logs, and confirmed deployment protection.
incidents.residualRisk: No Pinecone platform residual from this advisory; live authentication unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /indexes on the control plane. Data-plane indexHost stays caller-supplied; handwritten handlers admit only https *.pinecone.io hosts rather than interpolating them as a stored setup baseUrl.

Pins source API version header 2026-04 (a current stable version; latest stable as of review is 2026-07). Native category is dev-tools rather than AI/data because Rust CATEGORIES has no AI or data bucket.
Returns raw Pinecone JSON under data. Control-plane host is fixed at api.pinecone.io.
name is URL-encoded in the path. Official header name Api-Key is used; source sends api-key (HTTP header names are case-insensitive).
